notes.title: UEBS2 Release Delayed, We Want This To Be Great..
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  We want to thank you all for your continued support in our journey with this beast, Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2.  UEBS2 is already bigger than we ever planned, but we think we can still do better..

 We have decided to delay the release to (Hopefully early) spring of 2022.  We have been working super hard on both UEBS2 and The Black Masses.  As some of you may know, we just pushed The Black Masses to beta 0.1.  A great accomplishment for us here @ Brilliant Game Studios!  The open world title is currently on sale for 66% off, so head on over if you wish to support our other titles!

I hope everyone is having a fantastic week, we will be posting new videos soon so keep your eyes open!

Regards,

Brilliant Game Studios.

notes.title: Hotfix For V1.9
notes.notes:
Note: Is anyone playing with the RX 5500 and experiencing the black light issue?  We are looking into buying a 5000 series for debugging this light issue, but would prefer not to spend too much.

  Hello everyone, we have a quick hotfix for ya.  We made a few changes to the lighting and we need people with the AMD 5700XT to test the latest patch.  We really aren't sure if the issue has been resolved to be honest(Since we do not have any at the studio) but we made a few changes that MAY have fixed the black light issue.

Changes Made:

-Direct texture look up removed for shadow sampling and replaced with standard texture sampling.  
-Screen resolution added to options menu.
-GPU vram usage reduced in attempt to optimize for lower end hardware.  

Hope everyone had a fantastic Halloween!

notes.title: 2 New Maps, Max Armies Increase, AI Improvements - Update V1.5
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/0671d730bfbd99ca4e2076c338c785d5c5f837d2.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/5ead9b11df364210bbff82b7647c8771eaa44c01.jpg

 Hello everyone!  We have a big update for you today!  


Notes:

- 2 new maps are now live.  'City Of Atlantis' & 'War Torn'.

- New "groups" added to battle editor.  Allows you to have multiple armies on one team.  Each team can have 9 separate armies.

-Inverted mouse is now a thing!  You can chose to have inverted mouse on fly cam or in possession/fps mode.

-Super speed boost added to fly cam mode.  Double tap shift to activate!

-Ranged units now have farther attack range when they have the high ground.

-AI vision and enemy choosing has been drastically improved.  They are far more likely to spot an enemy as they get closer even in massive confusing battles.

-Rare bug which would break ranged units from firing projectiles is fixed.


The Maps:

-Atlantis city is a massive sprawling city for you and your armies to explore.  The city has 2 sides with 3 bridges connecting the 2 sides.  This beautiful city is in a deep canyon with water falls and lush trees surrounding the city.

- War torn is a open map with a desert like environment.  A massive wall separates the 2 sides with multiple choke points.  Parts of  the wall can be navigated by the AI, so set up your ranged defenses wisely!


  Thank you for being awesome everyone!

Regards,

Robert.

The wait has been long, but version 1.3 is finally here!  Here are some of the exciting new things in UEBS version 1.3!


- New game type, FPS Invasion.  Fight off hordes of zombies and creatures in first person, with your team of elite soldiers.  Rounds are infinite and the numbers never stop increasing. notes.title: Improved Mod Importing & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Mod importing has been dramatically improved.  If an error or any problems happen during import of a mod, the importer skips that mod and continues importing the others.  If there are any mods causing problems or conflicting with others, an error message is displayed after import specifying which mod is causing problems, while the other mods should continue working.

I hope this helps clear up some of the problems people are having with import errors and mod conflictions.

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Steam Workshop & Modding - Update On Development Progress
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/6b68fccc4ad66f9a85e4007ed62caf43670a871e.png


 Hello everyone!  I wanted to give you all an update on the progress that has been made in development of mod support for UEBS.  First I want to thank you all for your patience and support, I couldn't ask for a more supportive and active community!  

  It's coming, don't worry!  The actual development for the character mod tools and importing are basically finished and are in beta.  Now the next step is integrating Steam Workshop.  Try to understand, mod support requires a large amount of development time, it's challenging creating user friendly systems like this while making it streamlined and fast.  It's required thousands of lines of code.

  Thank you all for your patience.  I hope to have this out in under a week or so.(please do not quote me on that)

PS, That annoying bug with custom units not attacking will be fixed!


Kind regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FY28u4XrHzM



  It's been an epic and long journey, but version 1.0 is finally here!  Many 
exciting new features, with content nearly doubled from the last update!


 New Features:

- Ragdoll physics added.  A faked but very convincing approach on a scale your eyes have never witnessed.

- God ability, Breath Of God.  It's sure to 'blow' your mind. :P

- Music.  UEBS now has an official soundtrack!  Music is played during battles and menu.

- Arena in 'World Of Imperium' map.  If units are placed in arena, a thousands of spectators appear to watch the show.



New Content:


Maps:

- Large open world map called, 'World Of Imperium'.

- Volcano map with dynamic lava flow.  Lava randomly flows out of the Volcano killing all in its path!

- Modern City map.  City with modern urban like environment set in a large open sand desert.

Units:

- Modern running zombie(Melee)

- German soldier(Ranged)

- Skeleton warrior(Melee)

- Giant Cyclops(Ranged)

- Elf huntress(Ranged Hero)

- Soul Tyrant(Melee Hero)




Fixes/Changes

- Improvements to AI crowd/character avoidance.  AI attempt to eliminate single file lines and try to avoid congested areas.

- Buffed Golden Knight.

- Buffed Roman Soldier.



  Many other small features and changes were made.  I will soon be talking about the continued future of development in UEBS.  So please stay tuned, and have an amazing week!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: New Units, New Map, Fixes & Changes - Beta 0.2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28377569/9c93b288d84b3ae5a5b13028e03b6b58eb22b3b3.jpg 


Hello everyone!  Welcome to Beta 0.2!  I have added more units and maps as well as many other fixes and changes.


Content:

- Santa is back!

- New 'Inanimate Objects' category added to units.  Category contains tables and dressers so far.

- Dwarf unit added to Fantasy!

- New map!  Highly requested flat plain map has been added.  Great for head to head battles and faster performance than other maps.


Changes/Fixes:

- Audio settings with volume control on master and music is now in.

- Body piling has been optimized.  Piles now hollow out as they grow, increasing frame rate.

- Body pile height can now be infinite by activating 'infinite body pile' setting.

- Unit flying bug fixed.  Was caused when units went out of bounds of map.  Map boundaries now have invisible walls to stop this.



 Well everyone, I hope you all enjoy Beta 0.2!  Have a great week!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Beta Release & Performance Tips
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  I'm Robert, the developer of UEBS.  So the beta is finally released.  I want to thank everyone for the amazing support so far!  I want to cover a few things in this thread.  Being an early build, there will be bugs.  Please report any bugs you find on these forums.  Below, I want to give everyone a few tips about performance and understanding the graphics settings made available.

 

  First, I want to state that the crowd system requires memory.  Crowds are made of a great deal of meshes which require memory.  If you are having memory problems, try lowering the 'Character Animation' quality in settings.  This plays a huge factor into the amount of memory used in this game.


  Second, the rest of the settings play a significant role in the overall frame rate and performance you will get in the game.  

- The jump from high to ultra shadow quality is one of the most noticeable performance differences.  This is because each character casts his own shadow in Ultra.

- Character LOD can have a fairly significant impact on your performance but can make the characters have LOD popping issues when on low.  

- Terrain settings affect the over all detail in the environment terrains and trees which can also have a significant impact on FPS.

  That mostly covers performance tips.  I hope you all enjoy the beta, I'm so incredibly excited to continue working on this game and see what you all do in this sand box!

Regards,

Robert.

  Many people have been asking about the price so I thought I would post it here.  The price of the game will be just under $14.99 USD for a limited time(Price will vary by country). I hope you are all having a great week so far.  Stay epic!

Regards,

Robert.
